what: Navigation app with 'longer but less stressful' route option for anxious drivers. User: 'I wish there was a navigation app with an option like “longer route, but less brutal on the nervous system of an anxious driver.”'
why_us: High engagement (156 likes) on a specific, underserved pain in navigation apps (Google Maps, Waze ignore anxiety/stress factors). Recurring theme of mental health in travel.
revenue: Potential $5-15/mo premium or freemium with anxiety filters

what: City 'translator' app that maps unfamiliar cities to ones you know (e.g., Seattle neighborhoods to Istanbul equivalents). Founder launched twinhoods after thinking 'I wish there was an app for that!'
why_us: 371 likes on launch post, personal story of demand gap solved with AI. Validates idea for travel/relocation tools.
revenue: Launched as free site, potential for freemium or ads

what: Postiz (open-source social media scheduler) hit ~$352k verified MRR (10.3k subs at $34 avg). Grew from <$25k to $372k MRR in 2026.
why_us: Verified Stripe data via TrustMRR. Shows strong demand for AI-powered social tools in competitive space.
engagement: Verified data, high visibility in AI revenue leaderboards

what: Analysis of 9,300+ Reddit 'I wish there was an app for this' posts: 7% demand offline-first/privacy tools, top categories productivity (1,231), mobile apps dominate (61%). Subscription fatigue noted.
why_us: 741 votes on original Reddit post. Clear demand gaps in offline, local-only productivity tools. High repeatability.

what: Complaints about Lovable AI app builder: credits burning too fast, prices increased covertly (from ~$30/day to $200+), support issues. Users spent thousands with poor results.
why_us: Multiple 1-star Trustpilot reviews on pricing and reliability of AI coding tools. Opportunity for better-priced, more predictable AI builders.
engagement: Multiple detailed negative reviews, overall rating mixed but strong pain signals

what: DefiLlama launched side-by-side yield pool comparison tool with unique metrics (exit status, top holder concentration). 104 likes on announcement.
why_us: Addresses pain of comparing DeFi yields across protocols. High engagement from DeFi community.
revenue: N/A (tool feature), but signals demand for better analytics

what: Small AI-built SaaS examples: Glossa $14k MRR, AI Designer $8k MRR, 1ClickWebsite.ai $15k in 30 days, GETebook.ai $35k in 30 days. Median ~$5k among reported.
why_us: Real verified/self-reported revenue from micro-SaaS built with AI. Proves viability of simple tools.

what: Sports team filter: 'I wish there was a way to block literally everyone on this app who does not support your sports team' (X platform pain).
why_us: 81 likes on X. Common social media complaint about mixed feeds; opportunity for niche sports social or better filters.
